description: This file contains the implementation of the ModifyFeatureLiveCommand class, which is an immutable class extending AbstractModifyLiveCommand and implementing ModifyFeatureLiveCommand for handling live modification commands on features within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for command instantiation, feature retrieval, category identification, headers setting, authorization check, and response building.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the ModifyFeatureLiveCommand, providing functionalities to modify features in a live environment within Eclipse Ditto. It manages feature data, command creation, and response building.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl from a general Command object, casting it specifically to a ModifyFeature command.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the feature associated with this command.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the Feature object holder associated with the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the command with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization. Always returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for the command's response.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including its class name and superclass information.
